description: Normative Plugin Protocol v0 fixtures. schema_valid is the outcome of JSON Schema validation alone; valid is the outcome after the semantic rules in ../README.md. errors lists the exact set of error codes quivr plugin inspect (manifests), the engine Manifest validation (normalizer responses) the engine subscription output validation (subscription responses, judged against the request named by request), the engine connector output validation (connector fetch responses, judged against the request named by request and the manifest named by manifest) or the engine ingestion output validation (segment_and_embed and embed_query answers, judged the same way) reports or the engine retrieval output validation (search answers, judged against the request named by request and the manifest named by manifest) reports.
